proposed_facts.reason: Canonical initialization guards preserve non-disabled same-group states; the guarded callee updates position/history and the stated numeric capsule states, not debug registration.
The selector is a u16 eight-bit field promoted into s32. Cursor progression confirms three words for selectors 0–2 and 10–11, otherwise two.

Geometry uses literal 0.003906f, scale adjustment receives the reciprocal item scale, and timer handling distinguishes zero and F32_MAX. Compiled conversion consumers are appropriately left unverified.
The conditional ordering helper contains exactly the listed literals; it does not prove compiled section extent, padding, alignment or emitted order.
The described source-level numeric roles match the handlers and interpreter. Deferring compiled pool placement and conversion-bias interpretation is justified.
Five cursor increments consume the selector, ID/scalar word and three vector-component words: five total, not six.
The secondary adapter forwards both arguments without additional cursor movement; its delegated decoder consumes five total words.
Packed extraction, approximate scaling and mode zero match the decoder. The effect callee explicitly includes spread-bypassing and synchronous exceptions before default randomized placement.

Frame copying and transient-word clearing precede the null-stream return; timer subtraction excludes F32_MAX. Shared overlay processing forwards its separate context to the two-entry adapter dispatcher.
The command unconditionally resets and advances one word. The reset clears the countdown and pointers/blend enables without modifying profile-table priorities.
The wrapper unconditionally delegates to the fixed reset writes; the shared implementation distinguishes completion countdown from profile-table priority.
The wrapper has no local guard. The examined caller owns the external xD40 timing condition, while shared reset clears the separate overlay countdown.
Both construction reset sites are present. Constructor ordering subsequently invokes foobar, whose hold-kind 0/6 branch requests profile 3, so reset does not guarantee inactivity at return.

contradictions.reason: Resolve the debug-registration and same-group-state contradiction with proposal 0; preserve canonical Unk2/Unk3/Unk4 distinctions rather than inventing gameplay labels.
Resolve the signed packed-selector claim with proposal 1: the encoded field is unsigned despite the signed dispatch local.

Resolve all three numeric-pool claims with proposals 2–4. Approximate geometry scaling and timer roles are supported; accept explicit deferral of compiled extent, layout and conversion-bias use because no compiled evidence was supplied.
Resolve both event-width contradictions with proposals 5–6: the effect decoder consumes four continuation words after its initial word, and its adapter adds none.
Resolve universal asynchronous/randomized spawning wording with proposal 7; effect-specific early branches override that interpretation even with mode zero.
Resolve unconditional timer reduction with proposal 8, retaining both the null-stream return and F32_MAX exemption.

Resolve the three reset/countdown contradictions with proposals 9–11. x4_pri is decremented toward completion; request priority comes from table entries. Accept the broader shared-owner terminology audit as deferred rather than expanding this proposal.
Resolve guaranteed constructor-return inactivity with proposal 12. Both resets remain supported, but a subsequent hold-kind-dependent profile-3 request must be preserved.

Accept owner-scoped deferral of the rendered Item_PlaySFX collision: the general xD6C path and managed sfx_unk1 replacement path are demonstrably distinct and must not be merged. Existing owned semantic names and inherited unchanged knowledge are retained.

Original inferred-name spellings remain unrecovered. Existing semantic names are retained as hypotheses.
